node.label: Pelizaeus-Merzbacher-like disease
node.definition: Pelizaeus-Merzbacher like disease (PMLD) is an autosomal recessive leukodystrophy sharing identical clinical and radiological features as X-linked Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease (PMD).

mechanism_classes.label: primary hypomyelination (myelin is never properly formed; PLP1 / PMD spectrum, POLR3)

evidence.snippet: Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in (Assessed) — mal, T cell differentiation protein (MAL blood group)
via subtype leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 2 (MONDO:0012125): Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in (Assessed) — gap junction protein gamma 2
via subtype leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, 2 (MONDO:0012125): GJC2 is annotated as disease gene of OMIM:608804 (HPO genes_to_phenotype, OMIM-derived)

Pelizaeus-Merzbacher-like disease presents a similar clinical picture to Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease, however, it is caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in the GJC2 gene, which encodes for the gap junction protein Connexin-47.
Pelizaeus-Merzbacher-like disease (PMLD, OMIM #608804) is an autosomal recessive hypomyelinating leukodystrophy caused by homozygous variants in the GJC2 gene.
